leads.title: Supreme Court of Justice of the Nation - Jurisprudential Thesis of 3 June 2015 (cited as 14 June 2015 declaration)
leads.documents: Legal definition of marriage expanded to encompass same-sex couples; laws restricting marriage to man and woman deemed unconstitutional and discriminatory; orders every judge to grant amparo injunctions for same-sex marriage.
leads.detail: No URL visible in text; citation detail: '3 June 2015' release, 'jurisprudential thesis', Spanish term 'amparo' injunction process described

leads.title: Supreme Court of Justice of the Nation - Same-Sex Adoption Jurisprudence September 2016 / finalized 23 September 2016
leads.documents: Nationwide jurisprudence binding all lower court judges to rule in favor of same-sex couples seeking adoption and parental rights; includes 11 August 2015 9-1 ruling striking Campeche adoption ban.
leads.detail: No URL visible; citation detail: 'September 2016' ruling, '23 September' finalization, '11 August' Campeche 9-1 decision

leads.title: Political Constitution of the United Mexican States, Article 1 Amendments - 2001 and June 2011
leads.documents: Federal constitutional prohibition of discrimination based on 'preferences' (2001) clarified to 'sexual orientation' (2011); foundation for non-discrimination claims.
leads.detail: No URL visible; citation detail: 'Article 1 of the Federal Constitution', dates '2001' and 'June 2011'

leads.title: Federal Anti-Discrimination Law of 29 April 2003, effective 11 June 2003 - National Council to Prevent Discrimination
leads.documents: Federal enforcement machinery for anti-discrimination, creating a national council to enforce it.
leads.detail: No URL visible; citation detail: passed '29 April', took effect '11 June 2003', national council created to enforce it

leads.title: Mexico City Civil Code Transgender Reforms - 13 March 2004 amendments and September 2008 reform
leads.documents: Allows transgender people to change gender and name on birth certificates in Mexico City; 2008 law made process easier.
leads.detail: No URL visible; citation detail: '13 March' effective date, 'September' 2008 Legislative Assembly law

leads.title: Mexico City Gender Identity Law approved 13 November 2014 (plus Coahuila 13 November 2018, Michoacan 13 July 2017, Nayarit 20 July 2017, Hidalgo 25 April 2019)
leads.documents: State-level gender-identity procedures making legal gender change quicker/simpler via administrative process; key for trans legal recognition.
leads.detail: No URL visible; citation detail: dates '13 November' 2014 Mexico City, '13 November' Coahuila, '13 July' Michoacan, '20 July' Nayarit

leads.title: Inter-American Court of Human Rights Ruling of 9 January 2018
leads.documents: Holds same-sex marriage and recognition of gender identity on official documents are human rights protected by the American Convention on Human Rights, to which Mexico is signatory.
leads.detail: No URL visible; citation detail: date '9 January', American Convention on Human Rights cited

leads.title: Supreme Court of Justice of the Nation Ruling of 17 October 2018 on Transgender Birth Certificate
leads.documents: First-of-its-kind ruling allowing transgender person to change name and gender marker via simple administrative process based solely on self-declared gender identity.
leads.detail: No URL visible; citation detail: date '17 October', described as first of its kind in Mexico

leads.title: Federal Social Security and Pension Reform - Senate 6 November 2018 (110-0) and Chamber of Deputies 28 November 2018 (415-0); Supreme Court extensions 8 May and 11 May 2019
leads.documents: Codifies same-sex couples' rights to social security benefits, widow/widower's pension including concubinage, and right to register children with Civil Registry.
leads.detail: No URL visible; citation detail: votes '110-0' and '415-0', dates '6 November', '28 November', '8 May', '11 May'

leads.title: Presidential Decree 21 March 2014 and Presidential Declaration 17 May 2019 - National Day Against Homophobia / National Day of Fighting Against Homophobia, Lesbophobia, Transphobia and Biphobia
leads.documents: Government recognition machinery and policy actions: 17 May national day, labor inclusion, work with teachers to eradicate discrimination, protocol of action against hate crimes.
